_comment: Editorial changes made between research and publication, so the record shows where a published line is not verbatim what the researcher returned. Written by hand during the cross-category pass; see commit 92b3fe0.

coding.avoid: Rewritten to drop the 'buying for speed; the bottleneck moves to' shape, which Content Writing had repeated almost word for word. Finding unchanged.

content-writing.weigh: Rewritten to drop the 'they all demo well on a trivial sample' shape, used on five pages. Finding unchanged.
content-writing.avoid: Rewritten: as returned it was Coding's line with two nouns swapped. Now leads with drafts arriving competent and interchangeable, which was the researcher's own finding.

pdf-documents.weigh: Rewritten to drop 'not the model, the layer beneath', which Coding keeps. Leads with reading order and table cells instead.
pdf-documents.avoid: Rewritten to drop 'the citation proves where it looked', which Research & Search keeps. Leads with flattened tables instead.

data-analysis.moving: Rewritten to drop 'not the model'. Leads with the loop itself.

image-generation.weigh: Rewritten to drop 'cost per usable output', which Video keeps. Leads with whether fixing one thing preserves what is already right.

ui-design.weigh: Rewritten to drop 'they all look equal on a blank first screen'.

video-generation.avoid: Rewritten to drop 'judging on a single hero clip'. Mechanism unchanged.

research-search.avoid: Trimmed from 26 words to 24 to meet the length limit. Mechanism unchanged.

bookkeeping.weigh: Removed 'roughly 90-95%' — no source stated it; the researcher inferred it from vendors' own claims.

legal-contract.weighDetail: Removed a clause relaying the source's own product shortlist (three named tools). A third party's picks have no standing on a page whose job is our ranking. Mechanism unchanged.
